TC-24/S23.title: Phone width, WebKit and the Android app: the card's trash icon can be tapped without hitting the card
TC-24/S23.detail: Our own addition: record-only, findings are suggestions. Web half done (desktop, Pixel 7 Chromium, iPhone 15 WebKit), Android half blocked (device). The Hospital card's trash icon is 28x28 CSS px on all three profiles (>= 24 px WCAG 2.5.8; < 44 pt Apple HIG, suggestion), it is the topmost element at its centre (not covered), and a touch tap on it (Pixel 7, iPhone 15) or a click (desktop) opens the delete confirmation without opening the chart (URL stays /rounding). It is not a separate target, though: it is nested inside the card's role=button 'Open chart for …' element and fully inside its tap area (axe nested-interactive; suggestion A3, as in TC-01/S22). The Nursing Home list's delete control is recorded: there is none on Today's Visits or All Residents cards (B24 / Q7). Not run: the Android debug app on the emulator.
